in_marathi.name: Kavir
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kavir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kavir is a Sanskrit and Hindu name which means 'shining' or 'radiant'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kavi', which means 'wise poet'. In Hindu mythology, Kavir is also the name of a demon king. The name signifies strength, courage, and brilliance.
